svg.text: ESP32 dispatch console — wiring with the ESP32 beside the breadboard
Every line that starts at the ESP32 is a male–female wire: FEMALE end pushed onto the ESP32 pin, MALE end into the breadboard hole where the line ends. No two lines cross.

Yellow letters A–J = female–female wires from the ESP32 straight to the screen / joysticks. Numbered dots = their power wires (male end goes there). Blue tags (UP DN LT RT BK AC RJ IN) = panel buttons, see the bottom.
No buttons on the breadboard any more: the 8 panel buttons are wired straight to the ESP32 and the GND rail (bottom of the page).
beside the board · USB-C points left
BUZZER CIRCUIT — check hole by hole
• P2N2222A / BC547 read C-B-E → swap the two outer legs
• 1 kΩ: d46 ↔ h46 (must cross the gap) · ESP32 D21 → j46
• Buzzer: short leg (−) b47, long leg (+) b50
Numbered dots: female end on the device pin, male end where the dot is
Left stick GND → bottom blue rail
Left stick +5V pin → bottom red rail
Right stick GND → bottom blue rail
Right stick +5V pin → bottom red rail
Letters: female–female, ESP32 pin ↔ device pin (no breadboard)
Panel push buttons (12 mm, 2 lugs, no polarity) — each needs 2 wires
Lug 1 → its ESP32 pin with a male–female wire (female on the ESP32, male pin pushed through the lug hole and bent, or soldered). Lug 2 → top blue rail (GND) with a male–male wire.
• NEW v0.15: the knob (KY-040) and its 5 wires are removed. The RIGHT joystick's SW pin → ESP32 D4 (female–female wire F): clicking the right stick = NEXT. D34 / D35 are free now.

• v0.14: remove the 7 old breadboard buttons and their 14 wires. Each panel button: lug 1 → its ESP32 pin (blue tag), lug 2 → top blue GND rail (dark tag). INFO is the 8th button, on D19. Sticks' +5V pin goes to 3V3, never 5V.
• Turn the ESP32 so its USB-C points LEFT, away from the breadboard (its printed labels will look upside down — that's expected). Rest it pins-down on its wires, never on metal.
• Rails in THIS plan: top red = 5V (from VIN), top blue = GND, bottom red = 3V3, bottom blue = GND. Check each rail runs the full length. Columns 54–63 stay empty.
• Panel buttons have no polarity: either lug can be lug 1. Never use D12. Leave both sticks untouched while the ESP32 starts (it measures their centre).
• 2N2222 in c45/c46/c47 with its FLAT face (the side with writing) towards row e, i.e. towards you: E-B-C left to right. Buzzer long leg (+) in b50. TFT J1 stays open.
